simple.meaning: Penuel or Peniel , a place East of Jordan; also (as Penuel) the name of two Israelites

definitions.short: Penuel or Peniel , a place East of Jordan; also (as Penuel) the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H6439. Penuel מְּנוּאֵל proper name ( face of God , compare GFM JU 8, 8 ; late Assyrian Panîli Hilpr Univ. Pa. Exp. ix. 68 ); — Φανουηλ , but in Gen εἶδος ( τοῦ ) θεοῦ : 1. location east of Jordan, near Jabbok Gen 32:32 ; Judg 8:8 (twice in verse); 8:9 , 17 ; 1Kin 12:25 = מְּנִיאֵל Gen 32:31 : site unknown; see especially Paine Bib.Sac.1878, 481 ff. 2. masculine a. in Judah 1Chr 4:4 . b. in Benjamin 1Chr 8:25 Qr (Kt פניאל ).
definitions.rootNote: or (more properly,) פְּנִיאֵל ; from 6437 and 410 ; face of God ;
